features: The boAt WCDV 22.5W QCPD Dual Port Wall Charger supports 18W Quick Charge 3.0 & 22.5W Power Delivery and is compatible with all Micro USB, Type C and Power Delivery cables for all your charging needs.
Take charge of time with 18W Quick Charge 3.0 technology & 22.5W Power Delivery support.
The smart IC protection will keep your devices safe with built-in surge protection, short circuit protection, over current protection & overheat protection.
The Auto Detect Charging (Max 22.5W) adapts to your device’s charging needs to offer maximum efficiency.
The enduring capacitors having up to 10000 cycles is aptly complimented by its corrosion resistant pins for a long lifecycle of the device.
description: The boAt WCDV 22.5W QCPD Dual Port Wall Charger with 18W Quick Charge 3.0 and 22.5W Power Delivery support is the answer to all your charging needs. Its smart IC protection offers built-in surge protection, short circuit protection, over current protection & overheat protection. With universal compatibility, it will connect to all Micro-USB, Type C and Power Delivery cables. Its built-in auto-detect charging (Max 22.5W) adapts to your device’s charging needs automatically. The durable capacitors have up to 10000 cycles and is aptly complimented by its corrosion resistant pins.
